text: The Monster survives the burning windmill and wanders the countryside, shot at by hunters, chained by a mob, and briefly befriended by a blind hermit who teaches him "friend" and "good". Henry Frankenstein has renounced his work, but his old mentor Doctor Pretorius, who keeps homunculi in jars, has the Monster [kidnap Henry's new wife Elizabeth|who_suffers|spouses and lovers] to force his hand. In a storm, a [bandaged woman is raised to the lightning|threat|science playing god] and brought to life, and the Monster, [reaching out for a friend|wants|to be loved and belong], sees her scream.
